%c[ui_gray_2]Loners, or free stalkers, prefer to remain unaligned with the various factions operating in the Zone.
 The vast majority of the Zone's inhabitants belong to this unofficial brotherhood, choosing to live life without getting caught up in someone else's ideals.
 %c[0,255,246,156]Speciality: Jack-Of-All-Trades
 %c[0,255,246,156]Recommended For: New Players

%c[ui_gray_2]Chernobyl's outlaws know that while Ukraine and Belarus control the Zone on paper, it is in effect a lawless place.\n Bandits are killers, thieves and other members of the criminal underworld who exploit this fact, abusing the Zone's anarchic state to hide from the law and continue their illicit dealings.\n %c[0,255,255,255]Speciality: Loot Collection

%c[ui_gray_2]Duty is a paramilitary group, whose members live by a clear military charter. The ideology of the faction is to protect mankind from the dangers of the Zone and ultimately fight for its destruction. Duty is often set out to deal with the internal problems of the Zone, including mutants, anarchists and bandits. They are said to be funded by the government as they and the military have common goals: to contain, explore and destroy the Zone.\n %c[0,255,172,168]Speciality: Combat, Mutant Hunting

%c[ui_gray_2]An anarchist group consisting mainly of free stalkers, with the goal of preserving the Zone as a free territory and oppose the monopoly of the authorities. Although the group declares itself to be anarchist. Freedomers believe that the Zone cannot be defeated, and people should co-exist with it, seeing it as a great opportunity for research and study. They also believe that the Zone should not be hidden from the rest of the world.\n %c[0,120,235,120]Speciality: Combat, Exploration

%c[ui_gray_2]The Military refers to the Ukrainian government's internal troops, Spetsnaz detachments and commissioned stalkers. They guard the Zone from infiltration of unauthorized persons, taking a hardline approach to securing the border between the Zone and the outside world, they're known to shoot all unsanctioned personnel on sight. Soldiers have the right to shoot on sight as all unofficial persons in the Zone are considered armed and dangerous.\n %c[0,163,185,86]Speciality: Combat, Air Support, Equipment

%c[ui_gray_2]Sponsored by the Ukrainian government, the Ecologists are an official body of scientists and contracted field assistants who research the Zone, hoping to harness its potential for the good of mankind. Of all the Zone's factions, the Ecologists are the generally the most neutral, with their only real focus being on the pursuit of knowledge and science.\n %c[0,200,255,230]Speciality: Exploration, Artefact Hunting\n %c[0,200,255,230]Recommended For: Pacifistic Players

%c[ui_gray_2]Mercenaries in the Zone usually belong to a semi-loose company of professional fighters. These irregulars come from all sorts of nationalities and backgrounds, selling their services as veteran soldiers to anyone willing to pay and are known to kill anyone who gets in their way. Often carrying out contracted kills and robberies, most stalkers try not to cross paths with them unless necessary or desperate.\n %c[0,200,210,255]Speciality: Combat, Bounty Hunting

%c[ui_gray_2]A religious cult that is hostile to all but their own, the Monolithians believe in the power of the Wish Granter, rumored to be an alien artifact hidden in the center of the Zone. Members of this faction devote their lives to protecting the secret of the Great Crystal, ensuring that no one ever reaches the center of the Zone.\n %c[0,255,255,255]Speciality: Combat, Manpower, Psi Immunity\n %c[0,255,255,255]Recommended For: Advanced Players Only

%c[ui_gray_2]An independent scientific and paramilitary organization, dedicated to increasing the general understanding of the Zone while safeguarding its deadliest secrets. Although the group effectively collapsed after a failed expedition to the CNPP seven years ago, the few remaining survivors eventually rebuilt the faction to its former stature.\n %c[0,225,255,255]Speciality: Crafting, Intel Gathering\n %c[0,255,255,255]Recommended For: New Players

%c[ui_gray_2]The faction consists mainly of Bandits not organized under Yoga's lead and stalkers that broke off from other factions. The Renegades do not seem to be under a formal leadership and act as warbands and gangs instead. Most Renegades have committed transgressions so grave that no group will take them in, and even bandits just barely tolerate them.\n %c[0,255,50,50]Speciality: Giving Zero Fucks\n %c[0,255,50,50]Recommended For: Advanced Players Only

%c[ui_gray_2]Sin are an extremely hostile cult of mutant stalkers who believe in the divine essence of the Zone. Often described as zombified or possessed, these "dark stalkers" of the ominous Sin faction seek to expand the Zone to the rest of the world and they will stop at nothing to accomplish this ambitious goal.\n %c[0,225,114,50]Speciality: Friendly Mutants, Artefact Bonus, Psi Immunity\n %c[0,255,114,50]Recommended For: Advanced Players Only

%c[ui_gray_2]The United Nations International Scientific Group is a special forces unit with a keen interest in the Zone. Whatever their goal may be, their field agents are far from defenceless, and most would rather shoot first than risk information on their movements getting leaked.\n %c[0,155,100,155]Speciality: Stealth\n %c[0,155,100,155]Recommended For: Advanced Players Only

%c[ui_gray_2]Braaaiiinnnsss!!!
 Zombified stalkers are mindless husks, reduced to the most basic animal-like instincts and will attack almost anything that gets too close.
 %c[0,255,150,150]Speciality: Damage Resistance, Radioactivity
 %c[0,255,150,150]Recommended For: Advanced Players Only
